summary: G-Architects HRMS full analysis - bugs fixed 1 by 1, responsive + PWA + announcement expiry implemented

fixes.issue: netPayable subtracted employerTotal (employer PF/ESI deducted from employee)
fixes.fix: netPayable = actualPayableGross (no employer deduction)

fixes.issue: OTP logged in plaintext to console ([DEV] and fallback)
fixes.fix: Removed console.log OTP lines

fixes.issue: computeAttendanceSummary used UTC toISOString/getUTCDay while attendance stored via istDateString (IST) - weekend/holiday mismatch
fixes.fix: Use istDateString(cursor) + new Date(ds+'T00:00:00').getDay() consistently; fix sandwichDays and LOP loops

fixes.issue: Rate limit bypass via spoofed X-Forwarded-For (first value)
fixes.fix: Use req.ip (trusted proxy) only

fixes.issue: calcBusinessDays excluded only weekends, not holidays - over-charged leave balance
fixes.fix: Added holidays param to calcBusinessDays and query holidays in apply; skip holidays via istDateString

fixes.issue: Rejected/cancelled DELETE wiped ALL On leave% rows in range (overlapping leaves clobbered)
fixes.fix: Tag remarks with 'On leave: <id> ' and DELETE with LIKE 'On leave: '||$4||'%'

fixes.issue: attendance status CHECK lacked 'wfh'; WFH rows stored as 'present' and miscounted
fixes.fix: Added 'wfh' to CHECK + migration, INSERT wfh status, handle wfh in payroll tally, ID-tagged remarks

fixes.issue: 3rd-late rule triggered on 4th late (off-by-one, counted <3)
fixes.fix: Threshold >=2 instead of >=3

fixes.issue: Leave balance counted pending as used; new apps denied
fixes.fix: Balance query sums only approved for used_days; pending kept as pending_days

fixes.issue: TOCTOU race in cancel (SELECT then UPDATE)
fixes.fix: Atomic BEGIN/FOR UPDATE/COMMIT transaction with row lock

fixes.issue: Review UPDATE and attendance write-back not transactional; crash leaves inconsistent
fixes.fix: BEGIN/COMMIT wrap + avoid duplicate [regularized]

fixes.issue: Math.round(paidRaw) inflated presentDays and under-counted LOP
fixes.fix: Math.floor(paidRaw)

fixes.issue: Fallback used unvalidated form attendance values when compute failed
fixes.fix: Return 404 error instead of fallback

fixes.issue: absentToday compared '18:30' vs '18:30:00' string lengths
fixes.fix: Default '18:30:00' and isPastCutoff uses minutes comparison

fixes.issue: startAutoMarkScheduler created new interval each call; double-run with cron
fixes.fix: Singleton guard clearInterval; time comparison via minutes

fixes.issue: Endpoint hijack via ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE employee_id
fixes.fix: DELETE other owner's endpoint before upsert; no employee_id overwrite in conflict

fixes.issue: bcrypt cost 10 weak, password min 6 weak
fixes.fix: bcrypt cost 12, password min 8

fixes.issue: logout only cleared localStorage, token remained valid
fixes.fix: POST /api/auth/logout before clear

fixes.issue: Already-Z dates got extra Z → NaN; Invalid Date not guarded
fixes.fix: Guard endsWith Z, handle +- offset, isNaN check; formatDate guard

fixes.issue: Dynamically created img no onerror fallback
fixes.fix: Added onerror to hide img and show fallback

fixes.issue: Fixed 794px overflows on mobile (<820px)
fixes.fix: max-width 100% + overflow-x + media query 820px

fixes.issue: Priority badges missing normal/urgent mapping
fixes.fix: Added normal:info, urgent:danger

fixes.issue: Admin announcements had no auto-expiry; user requested Asia/Kolkata timed delete
fixes.fix: Added expires_at TIMESTAMP to schema, POST/PUT handling, GET filter (expires_at IS NULL OR > NOW()), /cron/expire-announcements, vercel crons, admin datetime-local UI + display + toLocalDatetimeValue

fixes.issue: sw.js deleted; PWA offline/cache not working; raw fetches bypass 401 handling
fixes.fix: Recreated sw.js with cache shell, fetch strategy, push handler; fixed 4 raw fetches (profile-photo, letters/generate, documents/upload, attendance/photo) to handle 401 redirect

fixes.issue: Admin mobile+PWA responsiveness check
fixes.fix: Verified body.admin-app/employee-app scope, .pp-sheet overflow fix, header btn-label handling already present

notes: All fixes preserve existing data (no drop). Timezone fixed to Asia/Kolkata per user. Employer contributions still stored but not deducted. Leave/WFH now holiday-aware and ID-tagged.
